title: The Poisoned Well
text: Water at last, cold and sweet, and the party has drunk deep before anyone notices the dead birds around the well, feathers stuck to the stones. Bellies start to cramp. Each House has a little antidote, enough for its own. It could be shared.

options.label: Pass your antidote round to everyone.

outcomes.text: Everyone shared, and there is enough for all with some left over.
You shared. Not everyone did, and your own go without.

options.label: Keep your antidote for your own.

outcomes.text: Your own are fine. The others are fine too, thanks to people better than you.
Every House kept its own. Everyone lives, and nobody forgets.
